task.title: Look at the sources of a fact
task.shortdesc: See which books and records back up a birth, a death or another fact, and change or remove one.

context.p: Each fact on a person's page has a small chip that counts its sources. A chip that says Sources: 0 means nothing backs that fact up yet. Every count of sources uses the same words, so you see them on a person's card in search results and on the Notes screen too.

step.cmd: On the page of a person, choose the chip beside .

stepresult.p: A screen named opens. Each source shows its title, its author and a quality line.

step.cmd: Choose beside a source to change it.

stepresult.p: A form opens with the title and the other details. Choose to keep your change.

step.cmd: Choose beside a source to take it off this fact.
To add a source, choose , then .

stepresult.p: A form opens. It has boxes for the title, the page, where the source is kept, the words copied from it and a note. Only the title is needed.
One more step offers to attach a copy of the source. You can skip it.
The list now shows the new source.

step.cmd: Choose again when you have finished.

result.p: You are back on the page of the person. The chip shows the new count.

postreq.p: A fact with no source shows the words No sources for this fact yet. and the button .
The screen that opens from also has a box to search for a source you have already added. Use it when one book backs up many facts.
